=================================================================
VanceSpectral Professional Plugin Suite - macOS Installation Guide
=================================================================

Version: 1.0.0
Publisher: Vance Audio
Supported Architectures: Universal Binary (Intel x86_64 & Apple Silicon M1/M2/M3)
Supported OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or newer

INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:
--------------------------
1. Double-click 'VanceSpectral_v1.0.0.pkg' to run the installer.
2. Select your desired plugin formats:
   [X] Audio Unit (.component) -> /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/VanceSpectral.component
   [X] VST3 (.vst3)            -> /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/VanceSpectral.vst3
   [X] CLAP (.clap)            -> /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/CLAP/VanceSpectral.clap
   [X] AAX (.aaxplugin)        -> /Library/Application Support/Avid/Audio/Plug-Ins/VanceSpectral.aaxplugin
3. Open Logic Pro, Ableton Live, FL Studio, or Pro Tools and perform a rescan.

GATEKEEPER & CODE SIGNING:
--------------------------
This installer package and all included plugin binaries are signed with an Apple Developer ID Application certificate and notarized by Apple.
